ns2:course.label: Social Aspects Info Tech
ns2:course.description: Explores the way in which information technologies have and are transforming society and how these affect a range of social, political and economic issues from the individual to societal levels. Same as LIS 202 and MACS 202. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing.
